questions.prompt: How many international tourist arrivals (overnight visitors) were recorded worldwide in 2025, in billions, according to UN Tourism?
questions.insight: Arrivals grew 4% in 2025, a new post-pandemic record year for international tourism.

questions.prompt: In 2022, what share of the world's total land area was agricultural land (cropland plus permanent meadows and pastures)?
questions.insight: Of 4,781 million hectares of farmland in 2022, pasture (3,208 million) covered about twice as much land as cropland (1,573 million).

questions.prompt: According to UNHCR, how many people worldwide were forcibly displaced (refugees, asylum-seekers, internally displaced and others in need of international protection) at the end of 2025?
questions.insight: That is about one in 70 people worldwide, and UNHCR reports the first annual decline in forced displacement in a decade.

questions.prompt: According to WHO's cancer agency IARC (GLOBOCAN 2022), how many people worldwide died of cancer in 2022?
questions.insight: About 20 million new cancer cases were diagnosed worldwide that year.

questions.prompt: According to ILO, Walk Free and IOM, how many people were living in modern slavery (forced labour or forced marriage) on any given day in 2021?
questions.insight: The estimate is 28 million in forced labour and 22 million in forced marriage, up 10 million people since 2016.
